changelog: Fixes 1.4.13.0, whose home screen came back empty on existing servers: a new database column was never added, so every catalog query failed. Missing columns are now added on every start. Includes everything in 1.4.13.0: ratings count for as much as their votes support, language weighs as much as genre, titles you keep skipping sink out of For You, and (from 1.4.12.0) starting a title no longer counts as watching it and For You changes daily. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.
